title: Resampled trusted monitor (open models, independent shards)
description: Ask the trusted model for its suspicion score several times and average the draws. A single integer rating ties many submissions at the same value, so a fixed audit budget is spent partly at random among the tie. Averaging independent draws breaks those ties and reduces noise in the ranking, which should push more attacks above the audit threshold at the same false-positive budget. Costs k times more trusted-model calls. This entry reruns the idea on control_open: Qwen 3.5 397B untrusted model, Gemma 4 31B trusted monitor, 590 problems, 8 disjoint test shards.

source.title: AI control: improving safety despite intentional subversion
